message.content: Use the Task tool with subagent_type general-purpose and run_in_background true to count slowly from 1 to 50 with the Bash tool, one 'sleep 1; echo n' command per number. Then reply: started

input.prompt: Count slowly from 1 to 50 using the Bash tool. Make one Bash call per number, in order, with the command exactly `sleep 1; echo n`, where n is the number (for example, `sleep 1; echo 1`, then `sleep 1; echo 2`, and so on up to 50). Wait for each call to finish before making the next one. Do not combine numbers into one command. When all 50 are done, reply with a short final report saying the count finished and listing any call that failed.
